name: open-list-simulator
//engines: Vite 8 needs >=20.19/22.12 and wrangler needs >=22. Cloudflare Pages git builds default to an older Node, so .node-version pins it there.

scripts.db:reset: npm run seed && wrangler d1 execute ols-votes --local --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute ols-votes --local --file=./seed.sql
scripts.db:deploy: npm run seed && wrangler d1 execute ols-votes --remote --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute ols-votes --remote --file=./seed.sql
